metadata.description: Architectural definitions for LLM-driven system decomposition based on Unified Architecture Framework (UAF) version 1.2
metadata.purpose: Standardized terminology for service_architecture.json generation and system analysis aligned with UAF 1.2 Domain Metamodel (DMM) and UAF Modeling Language (UAFML)

uaf_components.dmm: Domain Metamodel (DMM) - Part 1: Formal metamodel with VIEW specifications
uaf_components.uafml: UAF Modeling Language (UAFML) - Part 2: UML/SysML implementation

service.definition: Black-box functionality or capability exposed to external consumers
characteristics: Provides specific capabilities through well-defined interfaces
Can be composed of multiple internal components/functions
service.uaf_reference: ServiceFunction and ServiceInterface specifications from UAF 1.2 DMM with enhanced Service-Resource relationships

interface.definition: Boundary specification for data exchange and communication between services
characteristics: Defines data transport mechanisms and protocols
Enables but does not perform data transformations
interface.uaf_reference: ServiceInterface and ResourceServiceInterface contracts from UAF 1.2 with enhanced Service-to-Resource connectivity and Information Element flows

function.definition: Internal behavior or operation within a service that transforms inputs to outputs
characteristics: Performs specific data processing or business logic
May coordinate with other functions within the same service
Not directly exposed to external consumers
function.uaf_reference: Function specifications from UAF 1.2 DMM with Activity and Behavior modeling patterns

level_0.name: System Classification
level_0.purpose: Determine the starting point for decomposition

system_of_systems.decompose_to: Level 1: Individual Systems, Level 2: System Components

individual_system.description: Single cohesive system with multiple components
individual_system.decompose_to: Level 1: Major Components, Level 2: Minor Components
individual_system.example: Web application with frontend, backend, database

major_component.example: Authentication service with user management and token handling

level_1.name: Primary Decomposition
level_1.purpose: Break down Level 0 into major architectural elements

level_2.name: Secondary Decomposition
level_2.purpose: Break down Level 1 elements into detailed components

level_3.name: Deep Decomposition (Conditional)
level_3.purpose: Additional decomposition for complex or critical interfaces
trigger_conditions: Interface marked 'recommended' with no existing implementation
Interface requires >3 method calls or data transformation

existing.definition: Component is already implemented and operational
existing.justification_required: Reference to existing code, deployment, or documentation

recommended.definition: Component should be implemented based on analysis
recommended.justification_required: Rationale for why this component is needed

hypothetical.definition: Component might be needed but requires further investigation

template_validation.purpose: Ensure all files conform to required JSON schemas

graph_validation.purpose: Detect architectural issues like cycles and orphaned nodes

interface_validation.purpose: Verify interface contracts are complete and consistent

deployment_validation.purpose: Reconcile logical architecture with deployment reality
